g.title: swapb
g.text: Read the back in the front's place

g.title: surya
g.text: Surya OCR on the front + each extra frame

g.title: pick
g.text: Qwen3-VL picks which OCR lines are

g.title: rec
g.text: Reconcile: model's words replaced by the
OCR line they resemble; hspell spelling

g.title: codes
g.text: else Qwen3-VL reads the printed ISBN/Danacode
+ codes found in the Surya text

g.title: isbn
g.text: printed Danacode has no check digit:
cover text and author must agree

g.title: out
g.text: One queue item, front + back pictures

g.title: af
g.text: AUTHOR FIRST: the author's titles from the
local index / National Library / one web search
keep the one printed on the front cover

g.title: blurb
g.text: Qwen3-VL names the book; ≥ 2 results must agree
